summary: Frontend-only verification of the REPLY composer Write/Preview toggle in the in-conversation stream (Direct Talk with Mara for /alex). All 30 assertions passed across the 5 acceptance-criteria groups plus regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: drop-composer.tsx cleanly gates the Write/Preview toggle on hasBody and resets preview on submit — behavior matches spec.
Preview rendering uses the shared safe Markdown component; anchors receive target=_blank and rel including noopener/noreferrer/nofollow — safe defaults look good.

Minor UX note (non-blocking): when Preview mode is active and the body is cleared indirectly (e.g., via send), state resets correctly; consider also resetting preview on outside blur if attachments-only flow is ever introduced.
